name: herdr-graph-engineering
description: Graph engineering on Herdr: one orchestrator chat takes your ideas, runs each as a lane (its own worktree running a small graph of agent, gate and person steps from a pattern) until its definition of done, and comes to you only when a lane needs you. Thin: patterns and roles are small files, a few bash scripts decide what is ready and record results. Requires the herdr plugin, jq, yq and git.
